mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document( title, category, file_name, file_type, content, content_hash, source, document_version, processing_status, error_message ) VALUES( #{title}, #{category}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{source}, #{documentVersion}, #{processingStatus}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET processing_status = 'READY', error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND processing_status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, category, file_name, file_type, content, content_hash, source, document_version, processing_status, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET processing_status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND processing_status = 'UPLOADED'
